prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high-endurance performance and adequate carbohydrate loading

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with all meals and timing specified
Calorie intake supports endurance athlete needs (approximately 3000-3500 kcal)
Carbohydrate-rich meals strategically timed around training sessions
Plan is compact and concise (under 400 words)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring elevated calorie and carbohydrate intake with specific timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Strength training and muscle gain with post-workout recovery optimization

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers exactly one full day with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and at least one post-workout snack
Protein is distributed across all meals with emphasis on post-workout meal (minimum 30g protein within 2 hours of training)
Total daily protein intake supports muscle gain for an 82kg athlete (approximately 1.6-2.2g per kg body weight)
Meal plan is presented in compact, concise format suitable for quick reference
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-focused athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein distribution across meals and recovery nutrition post-workout

prompt_inputs.goal: High-intensity swimming training with 2 sessions daily (morning and evening), requiring sustained energy and fast recovery
prompt_inputs.restrictions: No dairy, no high-fiber foods, no heavy/greasy meals

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 3 meals that are easily digestible and won't cause gastric discomfort
All meals are low in dairy and fiber, with moderate fat content suitable for swimmer
Meals provide adequate carbohydrates and lean protein to support high-intensity aquatic training and recovery
Plan is presented in compact, concise format suitable for a single day
